portInfo.description: The Port of Corner Brook publishes cruise berth specifications for its Western Terminal (UN/berth code context 5878): length 362 m (1,200 ft) and minimum depth alongside at mean low water 9.6 m (31.5 ft), with Logistec Stevedoring Inc. as terminal operator and compulsory pilotage via the Atlantic Pilotage Authority. The port home page welcomes contemporary, luxury and expedition guests to Western Newfoundland’s fjord/rugged-coast setting and notes real-time arrival tools.
